title: Terms of Service - Atlas Mentor
description: The terms and conditions that apply when you use Atlas Mentor's MBBS-abroad counselling, application assistance, and admissions consultancy services.
body:
Terms of Service

Last updated: September 2026

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Atlas Mentor website and consultancy services, operated by Elitestudy Abroad Pvt. Ltd. ("Atlas Mentor", "we", "us"). By submitting an enquiry, contacting us, or engaging our services, you agree to these Terms.

Our Services

Atlas Mentor provides educational counselling and application-assistance services for students seeking MBBS admission at universities abroad, including guidance on university selection, application preparation, NMC-compliance information, and visa/pre-departure support.

Not a Guarantee of Admission

Atlas Mentor assists with the preparation and submission of applications, but admission decisions are made solely by the respective universities and relevant government/regulatory authorities. We do not guarantee admission, visa approval, or any specific outcome.

Accuracy of Information

Fee figures, intake dates, and eligibility criteria published on this website are provided for general guidance and are subject to change by the respective universities and by NMC (National Medical Commission) regulations. Always confirm current figures directly with our counsellors before making financial commitments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate and complete information and documents when requested.
  • Respond promptly to requests for additional documents needed to complete your application.
  • Independently verify university recognition status and eligibility requirements relevant to your home state/country before enrolling.

Fees

Any consultancy fees charged by Atlas Mentor, and their refund conditions, will be communicated to you in writing (via email or a signed service agreement) before you make a payment.

Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Atlas Mentor is not liable for losses arising from decisions made by universities, government authorities, or third-party service providers (such as visa offices or banks), or for changes in law or regulation after the date of our advice.

Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of our services after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

Contact Us

Questions about these Terms can be sent to info@atlasmentor.com.

This document is provided for general informational purposes. Atlas Mentor recommends having these Terms reviewed by qualified legal counsel before relying on them as a binding service agreement.
